text:
carla: Quick heads-up — I'm doing a small refresh of the Hello quickstart auth/snippet flow to match SDK v8 and the new token conventions. Will open a PR shortly. Checklist: update env var names, JS/py snippet tweaks, Dockerfile example, and run snippet smoke tests.
ben: Nice. Any breaking changes we should flag in the changelog or migration guide?
carla: Only a few: ENV var RENAMED from REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_TOKEN, and fetch snippet uses `client = new RedwoodClient({ token: process.env.REDWOOD_TOKEN })` instead of inline key. I'll add a short migration callout.
alice: Can you paste the updated snippet here so I can eyeball it?
carla: Sure — JS example I'm going to land (short form):
```js
// quickstart updated for sdk v8
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ token: process.env.REDWOOD_TOKEN });
const res = await client.text.generate({ model: 'redwood-alpha', prompt: 'Hello, world!' });
console.log(res.output[0].content);
```
david: I'll run that in the devcontainer and smoke it. Do you want me to run the snippet CI job locally too? The docs CI's snippet-runner is flakey on macs.
carla: Yes please — run `./scripts/run-snippets.sh docs/quickstart` and post failures. If you see the old env var in any file, mark with a TODO comment in the PR.
elaine: Heads up — linkchecker already flagged one old link in the quickstart: `/docs/quickstart/auth` -> we changed the slug to `/docs/quickstart/credentials`. CI shows a 404 on the redirect.
carla: Good catch. I'll update internal links and leave a redirect in the docs app.
doc-bot: snippet-runner started for docs/quickstart at 1765432220 — results pending.
chris: If you're changing the Docker example, remember to keep the minimal build for first-time users. We had complaints that the previous Dockerfile pulled in dev deps.
carla: Right — I'll swap to the smaller multistage Docker: just runtime install + env var example.
ben: I'll add a short note in the migration guide: "If you're using REDWOOD_API_KEY, rename to REDWOOD_TOKEN and rotate keys." Keeps support tickets lower.
alice: I can review the PR once it's open. Ping me with @alice and add the PR link here. I can do a quick pass for typos and sample output. :eyes:
david: Ran the snippet locally — two minor issues: (1) example in README still shows old env var in a bash block, (2) snippet-runner flagged a trailing comma in the python example (syntax on older py versions). Pushed a tiny branch with fixes to my fork, will open a PR against your branch if that's ok.
carla: Great — pls do. I'll wait for your PR and then consolidate. Plan: open main PR in ~30m, request review from @alice + @ben, CI: docs + snippet-runner + linkchecker must pass.
chris: one last ask — can we add a one-line note in the quickstart about "where to find your token" (console -> API keys) so new users don't get confused?
carla: Yup, adding that under "Authentication" with a screenshot placeholder and a link to the console docs.
doc-bot: snippet-runner finished: 2 warnings (trailing comma in python example, non-deterministic sample output), 0 errors.
carla: Thanks everyone. I'll push the PR and drop the link here. If CI flaps, @david can re-run the snippet job. :thumbsup:
ben: Thanks — appreciate the tidy up.
alice: LGTM in advance, ping when ready.
carla: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — assigning @alice @ben for review. (I'll update with screenshot and redirect after reviews)
david: Kicking off local e2e: `./scripts/run-snippets.sh docs/quickstart --container` — will post results if anything else pops.
carla: Closing the thread once PR merged. Thanks! :wave:
